summary:
The current-only programme cutover remains open. The owning plan now records accepted coherent 0.104 publication, exact installed payload qualification and genuine read-only migration preparation. Its separately selected original apply confirmed partial effects and stopped Unknown when an immediate complete readback still showed the pre-effect membership state; later independent observation confirmed those partial effects. Original custody remains readback-only. Restricted native records are retained outside the public archive. Source delivery, a current source scalar and a successful native job do not complete migration or transfer an original operation grant.

The selected visibility correction separates a clear correlated successful response from its later independent native visibility. Only a complete exact pre-effect witness, with the existing effect-specific timestamp allowances, can mean Pending. A candidate-confirmed witness must receive the existing final project/principal/capability identity recheck on that same data and establish both the returned identity and the exact selected transition. Contradictory witnesses retain the final identity barrier; partial pages, malformed/error/null responses, changed unrelated facts and uncertain sends stop. Standard preparation, precondition and original-path readback collection remain strict. A Pending witness grants only read-only waiting, never settlement, another send or an absence-as-NoSend inference.

The caller retains one original intent and sends once. At most seven data witnesses use waits of 1, 1, 2, 4, 8 and 14 seconds, within the same 500-request/270-second stopwatch and selected planning deadline. Waiting cannot renew the clock, counter, path or operation identity. Acquisitions are planning-window-bound; insufficient remaining time refuses. Complete pages are observation-local, never reused across waiting intervals or effects. The finite policy is best effort and can still exhaust its original limit. Cooperative initialization does not supply GitHub CAS or exclude arbitrary human writers.

Full-journey qualification matters: fixed first-five-second waits would exceed the original time window across seventy-seven delayed effects, and the first faster full-observation experiment exhausted 500 requests after seventy-one sends. The narrow Pending-only omission of a redundant identity query preserves confirmation guards. The corrected inert twenty-selected/twenty-two-member/eight-view journey uses 468 apply requests and 77 virtual seconds when every effect has one stale read, versus 391 apply requests without delay; separate preparation uses four requests. It preserves the five prior cards and produces zero writes on unchanged preparation. Both affected test projects built and 14 unit plus 34 actual-caller cases passed under a separately selected ordinary profile. Those source tests exclude real HTTP/custody/propagation latency, native pagination fit, installed changed-byte qualification and UI acceptance. Historical failures and static-review limitations remain retained.

The existing migration contract still initializes only explicitly declared absent Track/Roadmap/Status values; equal values are no-ops and conflicts stop without overwrite or rollback. Returned item/value identity and invariant UTC timestamps, existing option IDs, unrelated values, other views and orthogonal UI configuration remain protected. Observation, assignee, ownership and hierarchy writes stay excluded. Canonical owning-plan paths retain stable identity while fresh protected-main commit/blob provenance is observed. PR gaps remain purpose-typed: ObserveExisting and Implement may tolerate only review/check availability when their exact current native and action prerequisites hold; gaps stay visible and aggregate evidence incomplete. Qualification, activation and normal delivery remain conservative.

The published 0.104 package remains its immutable source-912 candidate, distinct from its later source-5a publication controller and this new visibility source. The canonical tool pin now selects that genuine published release; it does not install the new correction. A qualified successor, fresh native preparation, separately selected remaining migration, actual-ID final binding, positive installed inspect/refresh/selection, human UI and genuine existing-work/blocked/consumer activation acceptance remain. Legitimate human UI edits are fresh facts rather than grounds to freeze unrelated work. Product/schema1 and historical accepted outcomes remain separate; original .103 Unknown, the 439 holds and inherited reservations are unchanged.
title: Bounded migration visibility preserves original effects and separate cutover acceptance
